reduce-to-circuit:
(program (kernel-declaration (%kernel.4 () (Kernel)))
  (public-ledger-declaration
    ((%owner.1 (0) (__compact_Cell (tbytes 32)))
      (%withdrawals.3 (1) (Counter))))
  (witness %secretKey.5 () (tbytes 32))
  (circuit %claim.0 () (ttuple)
    (= %t.8 (public-ledger #t %owner.1 (0) read))
    (= %t.9 (default (tbytes 32))) (= %t.10 (== %t.8 %t.9))
    (= %t.11 (select #t %t.10 #t))
    (assert %t.11 "already claimed") (= %t.12 (tuple))
    (= %tmp.6 (call #t %secretKey.5))
    (= %t.13 (public-ledger #t %owner.1 (0) write %tmp.6))
    (= %t.14 (tuple)) %t.14)
  (circuit %withdraw.2 () (ttuple)
    (= %t.15 (public-ledger #t %owner.1 (0) read))
    (= %t.16 (call #t %secretKey.5)) (= %t.17 (== %t.15 %t.16))
    (= %t.18 (select #t %t.17 #t))
    (assert %t.18 "not the owner") (= %t.19 (tuple))
    (= %t.20 (public-ledger #t %withdrawals.3 (1) increment 1))
    (= %t.21 (tuple)) %t.21))
